dashboard.label: TA-disk Overview
dashboard.description: Collects disk health from smartctl (SATA/ATA SMART + NVMe) and /sys/class/nvme: health status, power-on hours, temperature, NVMe wear (percentage used, available spare), media

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-disk" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

single.option: key beacon within 3h - enter a key on the License page

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-disk. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-disk requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-disk", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-disk/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms
| mstats avg("disk.total") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("disk.smart_available") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="disk:status" _raw="*status*: *fail*" | stats dc(host) as value
index=main sourcetype="disk:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"model\":\s*\"(?<m>[^\"]+)\"" | mvexpand m | stats count(m) as value

index=main sourcetype="disk:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"model\"") | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | spath input=o path=model | spath input=o path=type | spath input=o path=serial | spath input=o path=smart_available | spath input=o path=health | spath input=o path=temperature | spath input=o path=power_on_hours | spath input=o path=percentage_used | table host k model type serial smart_available health temperature power_on_hours percentage_used

index=main sourcetype="disk:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"model\"") and match(o,"\"status\": \"fail\"") | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | spath input=o path=model | spath input=o path=type | spath input=o path=health | spath input=o path=percentage_used | spath input=o path=media_errors | table host k model type health percentage_used media_errors
